## Resonance Fields3 — Arcane Feedback receipt follow-through completed

**The supplied records do not contain a complete durable derivation of Feedback’s spent round-use.** I have supplied the narrow explicit receipt completion, preserving both existing **1 RP awards** and every original numerical, Action/Reaction, casting-history and spell-effect result.

**No field procedure, shared rule, class recovery law or selected question answer changes.** These three spells remain proposed pending your independent reconciliation. Applied **525/323/249/173** and **50 accepted-but-unapplied** remain unchanged.

## 1. Why an explicit receipt is necessary

The existing `castRecords` establish payment and resolution. `eventsApplied` can distinguish a repeated **whole event ID**. The observations record the numerical recovery.

However, those records do not supply the complete Feedback-specific relationship between **owner, original counter, negated spell and authoritative numbered round**, or a deterministic gate against a **different qualifying counter in that same round**.

The historical verifier’s Feedback calculation reads the observations to reconcile RP arithmetic. It does not define or check a consumed Feedback frequency record. That is a narrower finding than claiming an actual game engine has already paid twice. :chatgpt-content-reference{index="4"}[Exact class, timing and historical-verifier excerpts](sandbox:/mnt/data/DD_Rank9_Resonance_Fields_3_Part5_Feedback_Receipt_Return_02/SOURCE_EXCERPTS.md)

## 2. The two original positive outcomes remain exact

| Branch | Native payment and recovery | Added durable state |
|---|---|---|
| **RF9-NS-A-counter**, timeline 0, **E** | **64→61→62 RP** after `Counter1` negates `Nexus1` | Feedback round-one use and the complete original-source settlement |
| **RF9-NS-B-counterpulse**, timeline 1, **B** | **64→63→64 RP** after `ClassCounter` negates `EnemyFire` | Separate Feedback receipt; existing `counterpulse-round1: spent` remains intact |

Neither receipt grants another Reaction, repeats payment, modifies recharge, changes Dissonance/Refrain or turns Feedback into a base-cost refund or Singularity conversion.

The complete initial, before, after and final snapshots now carry an explicit private namespace:

```text
actors[owner].limitedUses["wizard.supplement.arcane-feedback"]
```

It contains **`roundUses`** and **`sourceSettlements`**. The initial namespace is empty; the successful award atomically records its spent round, completed source settlement and resulting RP.

The durable source key is:

```text
(scope ID, actual owner ID, feature ID, original Counterspell cast ID)
```

**Callback/delivery ID and the callback’s current round are not part of that key.** Renaming or redelivering a callback therefore cannot create another recovery opportunity.

The complete receipt retains the original event and round, actual negated cast, native source, qualification, pre-recovery RP, normal maximum and actual credit. :chatgpt-content-reference{index="5"}[Complete receipt contract](sandbox:/mnt/data/DD_Rank9_Resonance_Fields_3_Part5_Feedback_Receipt_Return_02/FEEDBACK_RECEIPT_CONTRACT.json)

## 3. Round identity and Reaction timing remain distinct

Both original awards are explicitly bound to their fixtures’ **numbered round 1**. That binding is not inferred from a callback’s arrival time or calculated through a new global `floor(seconds/6)` rule.

The actual combat source permits a late-initiative creature to react before its first regular turn and refresh its Reaction at that real START **within the same numbered round**. Consequently:

**An own-turn START can refresh Reaction while Feedback remains spent. A numbered-round boundary does not itself refresh Reaction.** Extra turns, field reentry and save/reload reset neither receipt. :chatgpt-content-reference{index="6"}[Source timing text](sandbox:/mnt/data/DD_Rank9_Resonance_Fields_3_Part5_Feedback_Receipt_Return_02/SOURCE_EXCERPTS.md)

Old source settlements survive the boundary. A delayed callback for an old awarded—or already denied—source cannot be redeemed as a new-round event.

## 4. Useful payment, replay and boundary diagnostics

The new isolated diagnostics include the two positive awards and these additional boundaries:

| Diagnostic | Result |
|---|---|
| Duplicate or renamed callback | No additional RP or other state mutation |
| JSON save/reload, then replay | Same receipt; no additional award |
| Original counter replayed after round advancement | Still a duplicate; no new-round credit |
| Real E START2 refresh | Reaction can become available; round-one Feedback remains spent; class Counterspell recharge is still **1** |
| Distinct, otherwise-lawful second counter in round one | Actual supplied **5 RP** payment gives **62→57→57**, not 58 |
| Distinct qualified counter in a later genuine round | Actual supplied **3 RP** payment and new award give **57→54→55** |
| Failed, copied, reflected or companion counter; dispel/absorption | No Feedback award |
| Actual recovery prohibition or normal maximum | No prohibited or overflowing credit |
| Missing or contradictory atomic receipt | Rejected as invalid evidence, not repaired by paying another RP |

The same-round comparison **does not reuse the unavailable class Counterspell at recharge 1**. It expressly requires the actual ordinary rank-three Counterspell, genuinely prepared beforehand, plus a real lawful pending-cast opportunity and the refreshed ordinary Reaction.

The source-qualified template already has that spell in its book, but it is not prepared in the original main fixture. That preparation and the complete native counter transaction remain **explicit conditional diagnostic inputs**, not newly granted acquisition or action permission.

Similarly, the later-round comparison requires the genuine regular START/recharge progression and a new successful native counter. **The reward diagnostic does not manufacture an opponent’s spell or execute the scheduler.**

Tests of prohibited or capped-zero recovery demonstrate nonaward only. They do not select an unrelated new convention for whether an otherwise-unused class frequency is consumed by a zero-credit trigger.

## 5. Complete mirrors and reversible reconstruction

The two affected full branch objects are synchronized across **MODEL, CASE_DISPOSITIONS and the Director’s complete casebook**. Their complete original and corrected values are included.

Removing only the added receipt/context annotations recovers each **entire original branch**. All other branch objects remain unchanged. The package still contains **seven main cases, 28 branches and four original conditional qualifications**.

The reconstruction paths are:

| Starting point | Operations |
|---|---:|
| Exact **Return01 MODEL** | **6**: three metadata replacements, two full branch replacements and one added receipt contract |

**These are alternatives. Do not apply both paths to the same state.**

**918 read-only source, reconstruction, preservation and mirror checks passed.** Fresh extraction, including the manifest, passed **968 checks**, with zero failures.

The new isolated diagnostic completed **31 cases and 64 assertions**, with zero failures. Its fresh-extraction rerun reproduced the complete diagnostic report **byte-identically**. All extracted return files remained unchanged.

The complete **54,459,580-byte Return01 archive** and the complete current follow-through packet are included unchanged. The original source/context archives and historical reports remain intact inside that history. Your supplied **3,099-check report is preserved, not claimed as a fresh rerun**.

**No supplied script, project module or game runtime was executed.** Only the newly written read-only verifier and isolated receipt diagnostics ran. Atomic production persistence, actual save/load recovery and native counter/event integration remain implementation work.
